# prime-button

prime-rs: Button component (port of PrimeNG)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/button) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-button) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/button.md)

Button — port of `p-button` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Classes, `data-p*` and content order (`children`, icon or loading indicator, label, badge) match PrimeNG.
Instead of the host element `<p-button>`, only `<button>` is rendered: the theme CSS is bound to classes, not to the tag.
Properties are `Prop`/`OptProp`: a static value creates no reactive primitives, a signal subscribes the attributes.
The icon is passed as `ViewFn` (for example `<CheckIcon />` from `prime-icons`), not as a font class name.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_button::{Button, ButtonSeverity};

let html = view! { <Button label="Save" severity=ButtonSeverity::Success /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-button-success") && html.contains("p-button-label"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-button = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["button"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
